team_name: LES DÉFONCEURS DE RECTUM SATANIQUE FC
design_description: An aggressive red-and-black striped design built on the Kinetic template, using torn brushstroke textures to distort and energize the classic vertical stripe layout. The jagged black claw-like marks cut through the red base, giving the jersey a violent, combat-sport aesthetic that fits perfectly with the Venum identity. Beige accents on the collar, sleeve cuffs, and sponsor soften the palette slightly while still maintaining the dark, intimidating tone. Overall, the kit feels fierce, raw, and high-adrenaline — somewhere between football culture and MMA-inspired streetwear.
